messages.subject: Senior International Executive | Government, ESG & Corporate Affairs Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Sutton,

Your senior executive-search work across commercial, government and complex regulated organisations aligns with my leadership background. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where organisational performance depends on institutional trust, stakeholder alignment and disciplined execution. I am internationally mobile and open to appropriate global appointments.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
